name: Sonic Mania Decompilation
description:
Sonic Mania Decompilation is a native PC port created from the byte-accurate decompilation of Sonic Mania (2017) and the Retro Engine v5. It runs natively on Linux with zero overhead and full mod support.

Features:
- Native Linux execution delivering responsive 60 FPS platforming action
- Widescreen and ultrawide display support with scalable UI elements
- Complete support for the Sonic Mania Plus expansion and Encore Mode
- Rich modding ecosystem with integrated mod manager support
- Modern gamepad and arcade fight-stick compatibility with rumble feedback
